newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose by 60.01 points to 5,992.68. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 3/8 to $61 7/8.
* The peso closed at 26.268 to a U.S.dollar from 26.260.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,131.14, up 0.88 ppinjts.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 11.84375 percent from 12.3125.

* Dharmala Securities Philippines said in its advisory to clients that the market outlook for the week remained gloomy with a slim chance of any potential upswing. The technicals of the Phisix indicate that there is still some downward momentum which may lead it to test the 3,000 psychological support level.

Dharmala said it advised investors to dodge the property issues, which make up almost 50 percent of the market capitalisation, for the time being. The construction and food sectors deserve a second look in the medium term, Dharmala said. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841 8934
